notes.title: Zombie D-Day playtest
notes.content:
Please playtest the first level of my new game, Zombie D-Day, which is planned for release early next year.
It looks like a few of you have already managed to find the playtest button, and have been trying it out.
Controls
If anyone is struggling with the controls the game should work with keyboard / mouse.
I have also tested with xbox 360 and PS3 controllers.
Move around and look around
Use WASD and mouse.
Use controller joystick 1 and joystick 2
Use weapon
Press mouse or controller buttons to fire or throw a weapon, or to use a hand weapon, e.g. fist, knife or hammer.
Pickups 
Pickups are activated by moving into them.
Inventory items can be scrolled by using controller bumper buttons, or by keyboard buttons o and p.
Switch weapons and items
Use the relevant controller buttons to switch between weapon selection, and inventory selection.
The keyboard button is e.
Exit
Pick up a key to enter a vehicle by moving towards the vehicle.
Use the relevant controller button to leave the vehicle.
Frame counter
Press the c button on the keyboard to remove the frame counter from the screen.

Please remember this game is still being worked on, and there maybe bugs to resolve., which is the point of this playtest.
Any CONSTRUCTIVE feedback would be welcome, at reessoftmail@gmail.com

If you're wondering why I left the frame counter in there it's because my PC is fairly old, and I'd be interested in feedback regarding the performance of the game on different hardware.

Kind regards
